context.build_profile: release; caller must build both release executables
context.filesystem_cache: warm/uncontrolled; cold means fresh application SQLite cache only
context.display: main internal display: 1512x982 logical, 3024x1964 physical, scale 2, 120 Hz declared; active/wholly-main guard per launch; physical presentation not measured
context.launch_method: NSWorkspace LaunchServices new-instance foreground activation; exact PID returned
context.termination_validation: process disappeared + validated atomic successful report; native exit status unavailable
context.attribution: verified app responsible PID (capability-tested undocumented macOS API)
context.background_load: existing user applications left running; background workload not neutralized

cpu_timebase_normalization.method: Mach user+system ticks converted to nanoseconds in the process reader before phase deltas

display.attestation: each launch validated active and wholly on main display via CGWindowList owner PID; refresh from CoreGraphics/system_profiler, scanout not measured

source_provenance.source_hash_algorithm: sorted selected git tracked/untracked nonignored app source/assets/package scripts, manifests/locks/configs and benchmark/fixture scripts; SHA256(path UTF8 + NUL + bytes + NUL)

cpu_timebase_conversion.method: proc_pid_rusage user+system Mach ticks converted to nanoseconds at every PID snapshot before phase deltas; no post-collection multiplication

cpu_calibration.method: single-thread bounded busy loop; direct self proc_pid_rusage vs time.process_time_ns and time.perf_counter_ns; only after all 120 app launches

context.launch_window_geometry_note: CGWindow rectangle recorded early during foreground activation may include opening animation; workload viewport is the actual validated 1440x888 content size. GPUI startup CPU-ready requires this viewport and records it throughout the scenario.
context.report_generator_post_measurement_change: After original source/binary attestation: correct committed-source wording, display start/end revisions and shared dependencies, use one decimal for physical-footprint gains, and display separately attested post-series correctness validation. Historical measurements and summary remain unchanged; post-series app source revision and hashes are recorded separately.

post_series_validation.note: La série de 120 lancements reste associée à la révision dbce1c7 (binaire GPUI 9be0a07486be…). Après cette série, le correctif 872d9ae refuse les résultats de coloration dont le budget de 500 ms est épuisé ; cette limite reste inchangée. Les nouveaux bundles ont passé un contrôle séparé de quatre lancements complets, avec 30 sélections de commit et 30 diffs réellement colorés par lancement, le même baseline Tauri, la même fixture et le même viewport. Leurs sources et binaires sont inchangés pendant ce contrôle. Les mesures et quantiles des 120 lancements restent inchangés ; aucun nouveau quantile de performance n’est publié. Le manifeste QA distingue les captures initiales et le contrôle natif du nouveau bundle de production.
post_series_validation.source_hash_algorithm: sorted selected git tracked/untracked nonignored app source/assets/package scripts, manifests/locks/configs and benchmark/fixture scripts; SHA256(path UTF8 + NUL + bytes + NUL)
post_series_validation.validation_scope: 4 full-workload launches only; not a new performance distribution; historical 120 runs unchanged
